why: I checked the expect lines against each must_catch item, and all three fail. Item 1: neither expect line asks for the error to name the file path or the line/position. That requirement shows up only in the outcome and the assumptions. Item 2: the first expect line is the trap itself: "loadConfig(path) in src/config.js catches the JSON.parse error and returns {}". It also has a proof attached, even though non_goals and assumptions reject that fix, so the output contradicts itself. Item 3: no expect line keeps a bad config failing with a non-zero exit and the app not starting. The only other expect line is "`npm test` passes". The outcome text does say "exit code 1 and without starting", but it is not an expect line, and the expect line that is there would make the app run on defaults.
